_doc: Writing styles of the typing policy besides general (prompt.json). Per style: title (shown to users), label (the App: line of the template), and optionally its own prompt: instructions ({words} = the words knob) and shots (text typed so far -> completion: the rest of an unfinished word with no space, or a leading space after a finished word). A style without its own prompt uses general's (the user's version of it, if any). Measured on bench/styles.json: general's prompt predicted chat, email, academic and code cases as well as or better than prompts written for those styles; work documents did better with their own (bench/RESULTS.md). Synthetic text only.

work.instructions: Continue the user's work document: if the last word is unfinished, give its remaining letters first, then about {words} more words. Formal, precise and professional, one sentence at most, never repeat the text.
